proposal.reason: Main change is in network/proxy behavior: per-communicator NET/CollNet backend selection and lifecycle, proxy append/progress/stop handling, and expanded NET request capacity. Add device-topology because intra-node NET vs P2P/SHM selection is now topology/affinity driven (new PATH_NET checks, NET reachability/path updates, PXN gating by backend version). Add memory for the new shared-memory handle/refcount API and ownership/unlink/close semantics used by proxy pools, which is an independently substantive resource-lifecycle change.
